北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阵雨，出门记得带伞，湿度高体感有点闷哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has showers. Remember your umbrella. High humidity makes it feel a bit stuffy!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波小雨，湿度高体感闷热，记得带伞，小心路滑哦！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has light rain, high humidity makes it feel muggy. Remember your umbrella and watch for slippery roads!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感闷热，多补水防暑，注意防晒哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, but feels hot and stuffy. Hydrate well and protect from sun!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感闷热，别忘了多喝水，注意防暑降温哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels hot and muggy. Don't forget to hydrate and cool down!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳今天体感非常热，注意防暑降温，多补充水分！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels extremely hot today. Prevent heatstroke, drink plenty of water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感炎热，多云风大，记得补水防暑，注意防晒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels scorching hot, cloudy and windy. Remember to hydrate and protect from sun!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨，湿度高有点闷，风力大，记得带伞注意安全！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain, high humidity makes it muggy. Windy, bring an umbrella and stay safe!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都大雨伴强风，出行务必注意安全，添衣保暖别着凉！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has heavy rain and strong winds. Please stay safe, dress warmly to avoid catching cold!
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降11℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云炎热，风力强劲，注意防暑降温，补水防晒！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and scorching, with strong winds. Prevent heatstroke, hydrate and sun protect!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴热，体感极高，记得防暑降温，避免长时间暴晒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and extremely hot. Remember to prevent heatstroke and avoid prolonged sun exposure!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云酷热，体感超 40℃，务必多饮水，注意防暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and intensely hot, feels over 40℃. Please drink plenty of water to prevent heatstroke!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨中雨，出门带伞，注意路滑，湿度高有点闷！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has moderate rain, bring an umbrella. Watch for slippery roads, high humidity feels muggy!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云炎热，体感较高，记得补水防晒，注意防暑哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and hot, feels quite warm. Remember to hydrate, sun protect, and prevent heatstroke!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感微凉，湿度高。记得添衣保暖，别着凉！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels cool, with high humidity. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching cold!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天闷热，多喝水，注意防暑降温，风力较大！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and muggy. Drink water, prevent heatstroke. It's quite windy!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云风力强，体感适宜，出门注意防风，小心着凉！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and windy, feels pleasant. Watch out for strong winds when going out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云风力强，体感舒适但湿度高，记得防风保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and windy, feels comfortable but humid. Remember to protect from wind and stay warm!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦大雨伴强风，出门带伞，注意交通安全，别着凉！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has heavy rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella, watch for traffic, and don't catch cold!
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雨，雨势较大，出行注意安全，路面湿滑哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has heavy rain. Please stay safe when out and about, roads are slippery!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃
